title: Wool Felted Jersey Pant
description:
Background: Designed by Shelby Grochowski, fabrication and patterning by Bobby Cabbagestalk. These Wool Felted Pants were worn in the Yeezy Season 8 Runway Show, intended for release in September - October of 2020. They were going to retail for $200 according to the Yeezy Supply Developer website for Season 8.

"So you’re going to have the clothes in Wyoming?"

"Yeah, the waterproof stuff [smiles]. But we have 700 sheep on my ranch, so we’re trying out different ways of felting the wool. It’s the beginning of a new language, because before [Yeezy] was based on military. The idea now is to be in service — like Sunday Service. Service clothing." - Ye

"Is the wool from the sheep on your ranch?"

"It will be. This is all experimental. We’re just looking at different ways of doing things. I mean, 90 percent of the collection is in muslin. It’s just in its original [form]. We’re looking into creating sueded effects." - Ye

title: LS-03 MASK (1 Star)
description:
Background: Designed by Mark Seekings and Jurgen Maelfeyt, the LS-03 Mask would be released for Ye’s GelreDome, Dinamo, Tampa, & San Antonio concerts, but these would only feature 1 star on each sleeve compared to those sold at SoFi Stadium.

Only White would re-release online for the San Antonio Concert.

The LS-03 features a star on the chest and sleeves and a wrestling mask on the back.

The release also featured a price increase, with the mask selling for $70 compared to its original $20 price on yeezy.com. It is also made in the USA.
